lessons_used: Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests.
Finish hint, adoption layout, and home wait info changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Cloud sync assurance sign in redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen with a full-bleed layout showcasing persistent cloud pet backup and account sync security.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making cloud sync assurance critical at sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to keep your pet safely saved in the cloud

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen within onboarding while maintaining account sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong win rate for sign_in redesign (3/4 tests) and strong support email evidence.

candidates.title: Welcome story overview new screen
candidates.change: Add a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces the companion pet experience with animated visuals.
candidates.why: 78.9% choose_path conversion with a long mean duration (514s) indicates users need clearer context before choosing a path.

new_welcome_overview.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
new_welcome_overview.body: Choose how you want to create your pet and bring your desktop to life.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new introductory screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a screen introduces friction; past choose_path new_screen test lost conversion (-3.2%).

candidates.title: Desktop widget placement new flow on home intro
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive widget setup flow on the final welcome screen showing how to dock and un-dock the pet.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion after onboarding regarding how to control or hide the pet (3 emails) and desktop features misbehaving (4 emails).

components.text: Pin pet to desktop taskbar | Drag to reposition | Right-click for options

guard.reason: text in 'home_intro.components[1].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['|']

candidates.title: Two column certificate preview redesign in adoption
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a two-column layout with a live pet certificate frame preview.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 68.5% conversion with 89s median time; a clearer side-by-side design boosts completion confidence.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Photo preparation guide new screen in adoption
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual preparation guide screen before uploading custom photos to ensure high-quality custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drops to 68.5%.

new_photo_setup_guide.headline: Tips for the Best Custom Pet Photo
new_photo_setup_guide.body: Use well-lit photos with clear face visibility for best pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adds a valid photo preparation guide screen prior to uploading photos within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with direct support mail backing, though new screens add release overhead.

candidates.title: Custom pet style upload guidance copy update
candidates.change: Update headline and body text on the pick friend step emphasizing customizable species traits.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.

pick_friend.headline: Choose your companion species and custom style
pick_friend.body: Select a base pet companion style below to ensure proper rendering on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on pick_friend screen that maintains its core function.

candidates.score_note: Very low cost copy tweak directly addressing user confusion on a high-friction step.

candidates.title: Background rendering completion system notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop system notifications when pet generation completes while the window is in the background.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s), causing drop-off if users navigate away during render.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet render is ready!

guard.reason: Adds completion notifications on the waiting screen, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step already has high conversion (89.3%) and notification tests previously failed.

candidates.title: Path creation duration hint on choose path
candidates.change: Add an explanatory time duration hint on the choose path options screen comparing preset versus photo routes.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s (median 8s), suggesting decision hesitation for slow users.

choose_path.hint: Quick pick takes ~1 min. Custom photo upload takes ~3 mins.

guard.reason: text in 'choose_path.hint' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: First week food pouch bonus incentive on finish screen
candidates.change: Display a welcome bonus pet food pouch reward badge on the final onboarding screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8%, overall completion only 26.3%, benefiting from a finishing reward.

guard.reason: Mentions a 'Free' item/gift in onboarding copy, violating the pricing copy restrictions.

candidates.title: Step by step pet generation wait info status
candidates.change: Display detailed generation progress steps with step counter and active process indicator during waiting.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a high mean (2336s), leaving users unsure of background activity.

guard.reason: Adds detailed progress information to the waiting screen as permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes showed no clear effect in past tests (+0.5% baseline). Target step drop is low.
